'''Davla''' was the only true land mass on the planet [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]. Located in the southern polar regions, Davla was a frigid land of constant volcanic activity.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''[[Player's Guide to Tapani]]'' incorrectly states that Davla was covered with verdant forests.
